propositions: Configuring direct-Anthropic fallback arms in rebar.toml for frontier and standard model classes is blocked until per-attempt capability resolution replaces whole-chain conservative intersection.

The existing whole-chain capability intersection silently downgrades native structured output to prompted output when a mixed Bedrock/Anthropic fallback chain is configured, regardless of primary model capability.

Direct Anthropic Sonnet has been live-proven to support both native structured output and thinking, resolving the capability asymmetry that previously required fallback configuration to remain disabled.
Prompt caching must be conservatively disabled across mixed Bedrock/Anthropic chains because their provider-specific cache styles differ incompatibly.
The fallback mechanism requires an explicit per-attempt request-shaping redesign or candidate adapter to honor primary-model output shapes when fallback candidates cannot support them.
